id.description: owner.name, lowercase letters, digits and underscores. The prefix 'absent.' is reserved for built-ins.

api.description: Host API version. 1 allows recipes and effects; 2 also allows scripts. The app supports both.

permissions.description: Shown at install. The host grants none yet.

recipes.description: Paths of recipe JSON files inside the package.

effects.description: Effect keys. Each needs effects/<key>.json and an entry in effects/index.json.

scripts.description: Paths of JavaScript files inside the package. Needs api 2.

scriptPath.description: Relative path with forward slashes that stays inside the package and ends in .js.

packagePath.description: Relative path with forward slashes that stays inside the package.
